documents.text: Employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave. Vacation time must be requested in the HR portal, and unused time off expires on December 31.
Password credentials are reset through the IT self-service portal. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every corporate account.
Expense receipts must be submitted within 30 calendar days. A direct manager approves reimbursement before finance issues repayment.
Employees may work remotely on Tuesday and Thursday after manager approval. Other weekdays require an exception from People Operations.
Report suspected security incidents immediately to the Security Operations Center. Preserve system logs and do not alter affected devices.
Application logs are retained for 90 days. Customer data exports automatically expire seven days after creation.
Domestic flights under six hours must be booked in economy class. International trips require director approval before booking.
Eligible primary caregivers receive 12 weeks of paid parental leave. Eligibility begins after six months of employment.
The primary on-call engineer acknowledges a page within 10 minutes. Escalate to the secondary engineer after two unanswered alerts.
Production databases receive encrypted backups every six hours. Recovery exercises test restoration once each quarter.
New production access requires a ticket, manager approval, and security review. Access is recertified every 90 days.
Production deployments occur Monday through Thursday before 3 PM Pacific. Friday releases require incident commander approval.
Security must assess vendors that process customer data before contract signature. Legal reviews contracts valued above $50,000.
Standard laptops are replaced on a four-year cycle. Lost equipment must be reported to IT and Security within one hour.
Employees complete security awareness training during onboarding and every 12 months thereafter. Overdue accounts may be suspended.
Public API clients are limited to 100 requests per minute. A Retry-After header communicates the backoff period after rate limiting.
Priority-one customer incidents receive an initial response within 15 minutes. The support lead posts updates every 30 minutes.
Customer records use AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Encryption keys rotate every 180 days.
Verified deletion requests are completed within 30 days. Legal holds pause deletion until the hold is released.
New employees have a 90-day introductory period. Managers conduct a formal check-in at day 45.
